identity.name: Calatrava
identity.one_liner: The 39mm Calatrava with an invisible-hinge officer's caseback — Patek's plainest watch hiding its best case trick.

narrative.story: Introduced at Baselworld 2013, the 5227 updated the core Calatrava to 39mm and gave it a hunter-style officer's caseback whose hinge is machined invisibly into the caseband — you only find it with a fingernail. Time, date, center seconds, nothing else. It is the watch Patek points to when asked what the house does without complications.
narrative.collector_notes: Open the dust cover before buying: the hinge and cover fit are where wear shows. Early examples carry caliber 324 S C, later ones 26-330 S C — the certificate settles which.
